items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: That was under the direction of Leon Herniford. ... The leader and director was a saxophonist and violinist, Leon Herniford.

ctx.x: Well, as we conclude this very special interview with you Mr. Blakeney, and we could just talk for hours and hours and hours and hours and use up all of the tape in Los Angeles County, is there anything that you'd like to say in conclusion, from your beginnings in the State of Mississippi up until this afternoon, June 24, 1982, when you're sitting here looking fit as a fiddle. No one would ever know of your most recent, very serious illness; is there anything you'd like to say to those that will be listening to…

I would say the highlight of my musical career was during the thirties. I was playing up and down Central Avenue. I'd say the highlights would be when we were playing the Lincoln Theater because we were exposed to the whole
town on the stage. That was under the direction of Leon Herniford. I think I mentioned that earlier. I don't know if I mentioned the personnel of that band.
